steps.instruction: Fry 4 strips of bacon in one layer over medium heat, turning often.
steps.spoken: Fry 4 strips of bacon in one layer over medium heat, turning often, until browned and crisp to your taste. Lower the heat if the fat starts to spatter.

steps.instruction: Move the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels.
Pat the bacon with another paper towel to remove extra fat.
Pour most of the fat into a teacup, leaving the brown bits in the pan.
Wash and dry the pan, then put it back on the heat.
Pour about 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat back into the pan.

steps.spoken: Crack 2 eggs into the pan and fry them for about 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Season the eggs with salt and pepper.
Break the yolks, spread them over the whites and flip the eggs.
Fry the eggs for 1 more minute.
Make 2 sandwiches with the muffins, bacon and eggs.
